data.name: Golden Years Nursing Home
data.detailed_description:
On your first night as a newly hired nurse at Golden Years Nursing Home, nothing feels quite right. The halls are too quiet. The lights hum with an uneven buzz. The few remaining residents seem confused, frightened, or unwilling to speak about what happened during the facility’s final weeks before its sudden closure in 1997.

Your job is simple on paper: complete your rounds, check on patients, log incidents, and keep the night calm. But as the hours pass, the building begins to show its age and its memories. Doors shift when you’re not looking. Call lights flicker from empty rooms. Staff records don’t match the residents you meet. And something in the dark seems to be moving with purpose.

Golden Years is a slow‑burn psychological horror experience focused on atmosphere, tension, and environmental storytelling. There is no combat. Your tools are your flashlight, your clipboard, and your willingness to keep going when every instinct tells you to leave.

Features

  • A grounded 1990s nursing‑home setting based on real‑world references

  • Night‑shift tasks that slowly unravel into something far more unsettling

  • A dynamic tension system that reacts to your behavior and choices - (coming soon)

  • A story told through rooms, records, and the residents who remain - (coming soon)

  • New Maps to be added in the future as well!

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB | AMD Radeon RX 580 | Intel Iris Xe
